decoded_text: {"obligations":[{"source_ids":["m05"],"text":"You're free to tune the filtering and timing details yourself as the project evolves, but don't change either alert threshold without asking me first."},{"source_ids":["m15"],"text":"Retire the 98% near-full alert — the tank has a physical overflow pipe to the storm drain, so a truly full tank is harmless and that alert would just be noise."},{"source_ids":["m15"],"text":"Replace it with a rapid-inflow indicator — if the level climbs more than 8 percentage points within an hour, set heavy_inflow=true in the payload, and clear it once the rise settles."},{"source_ids":["m17"],"text":"When that reads 3 °C or below, switch the loop into frost-watch — sample every 60 seconds instead of five minutes, and add frost_warning=true to the payload. Once it's back above 4 °C, return to normal."},{"source_ids":["m19"],"text":"You're now allowed to adjust the smoothing window yourself when the noise warrants it — but never below 3 readings."},{"source_ids":["m21"],"text":"Store-and-forward for up to 24 hours is pre-approved."},{"source_ids":["m27"],"text":"Reinstate the 98% near-full alert — but log-only this time: record it and show it in the weekly report, and never sound the buzzer or show the dashboard banner for it, whether or not demo mode is on."},{"source_ids":["m29"],"text":"It should only appear in weeks where frost-watch actually ran — don't print a zero-activity line."},{"source_ids":["m33"],"text":"Threshold and cadence settings read from a single shared config that firmware, dashboard and report all consume, so we never get three components disagreeing about what 15% means."},{"source_ids":["m35"],"text":"heavy-inflow should also get a line in the weekly report for any week it fired — same conditional treatment as the frost line."}]}
